from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import product, permutations

# Balls: (color, number)
balls = ([("R", 1)] * 2 + [("R", 2)] * 4 + [("B", 1)] * 1 + [("B", 2)] * 2)
n = len(balls)

# Part (1): with replacement, ordered pairs of ball indices
cnt = 0
for i, j in product(range(n), repeat=2):
    a, b = balls[i], balls[j]
    reds = (a[0] == "R") + (b[0] == "R")
    if reds == 1 and a[1] + b[1] == 3:
        cnt += 1
p1 = F(cnt, n * n)
print("Part 1 computed:", p1, "claimed: 8/81")

# Part (2): without replacement, ordered pairs of distinct balls
tot = 0
cA = cB = cAB = 0
for i, j in permutations(range(n), 2):
    tot += 1
    A = balls[i][0] == "R"
    B = balls[j][1] == 1
    cA += A
    cB += B
    cAB += (A and B)
PA, PB, PAB = F(cA, tot), F(cB, tot), F(cAB, tot)
print("P(A) =", PA, "claimed 2/3")
print("P(B) =", PB, "claimed 1/3")
print("P(AB) =", PAB, "P(A)P(B) =", PA * PB, "independent:", PAB == PA * PB)

ok2 = (PA == F(2, 3) and PB == F(1, 3) and PAB == PA * PB)
print("Part 1 correct:", ok1)

print("CHECK PASS" if ok1 and ok2 else "CHECK FAIL")
